_about: First-30-days thresholds for every brand. Read by check_thresholds.py; see launch-metrics-30-days.md for sources and reasoning. Keys under 'scorecard' match contentfactory.stats.scorecard() output (platforms.youtube/tiktok: views, watch_hours, impressions, ctr, subscribers, videos; site: visitors, signups, clicks). Keys under 'manual' are numbers typed into a small JSON each week from Instagram, Pinterest, Etsy, Gumroad and the email tool, which factory stats doesn't import yet.

rules.action: Impressions CTR under 2% (YouTube: half of channels sit between 2% and 10%). Change title and thumbnail on the 3 lowest videos, one at a time; use Test & compare.
YouTube barely shows the videos. Check titles for search phrases (youtube-seo-playbook.md), make sure videos are public, and add 2 search-led long videos on the most searched topics.

Under 50 watch hours in the latest export. YPP needs 8,000 a year (about 22 a day), so long-video retention is the lever: tighten the first 30 seconds and add the original element (chart or screen recording).
TikTok average under 200 views a video after 10+ posts. Change the hook mechanic (hooks_library.json) and the first frame before posting more.
Under 2% of site visitors sign up. Move the form above the fold on the top 3 landing pages, and test a different lead magnet headline.
Under 100 site visitors. Check that every bio and pin links with UTM tags (docs/UTM.md) and that Pinterest is posting.
Few sends per reach (Mosseri: sends drive reach to new people). Add a 'send this to...' last slide and more checklist carousels; judge each post at 72 hours.
Under 30% of reach from non-followers. Use Trial Reels once eligible, and collab posts between our brands.
Under 10 saves after 20+ pins and 30 days. Re-check pin titles for search phrases (pinterest-playbook-2026.md) and board descriptions. Don't judge Pinterest before day 30.
Impressions without clicks. Each pin must link to the page it promises (no hub pages), with the number or checklist on the image.
Over half the listings have under 20 visits in 14 days: an SEO problem. Fix titles, tags and first photos (etsy-seo-playbook.md), not prices.
Shop conversion under 0.5% (new shops typically 0.5-2%). Visits but no orders points to photos, description or price: check the top 5 most-visited listings first.
Under 1% of Gumroad page views buy. Tighten the first screen (what it is, who it's for, the price) and add page previews.
Welcome email opens under 30% (Mailchimp Business & Finance average 31%, inflated by Apple Mail Privacy). Check spam placement with a seed inbox and domain authentication, then the subject line.
Clicks under 2% (Mailchimp Business & Finance 2.78%). One link per email, placed early, pointing at one thing.
Unsubscribes over 0.5% per send (Mailchimp average 0.15-0.22%). Cut frequency or make the sign-up promise match what's sent.
Bounces over 2%. Pause sends, remove bad addresses, and check the sign-up form for typos and bots before sending again.

Any strike, warning, reduced-distribution notice or monetization flag: stop posting on that platform for the brand, read the notice, fix the cause (launch-playbook.md stop rules) and tell Dhruv the same day.
Spam complaints over 0.1% (Google's sender guidelines ask to stay below 0.1% and never reach 0.3%). Pause campaigns and check consent and frequency.
